question: Where can I get cadastral parcel boundaries (geometry) for all of Germany, with parcel identifier and area, as a bulk download or as a queryable service?

answer.summary: No free single dataset or API covers all of Germany. Cadastre (ALKIS) is run by the 16 Bundesländer: 15 publish free parcel polygons, 20-char parcel IDs (Flurstückskennzeichen), and official area (m²) without owners via state WFS, OGC API Features, or bulk downloads. Bavaria (LDBV) omits free vector parcels (FS-BY costs 56,000 EUR/yr; free WMS Parzellarkarte lacks parcel IDs). Only paid quarterly bulk contracts via ZSHH FS-DE (from 27,000 EUR/yr) + FS-BY (56,000 EUR/yr) cover all 16 states (~83,000+ EUR/yr, no API). BKG FS-DE (15 states) is restricted to V GeoBund federal agencies; Esri flstk_DE gives a free CC BY 4.0 REST API for those 15 states.
main_caveats: Bavaria (~20% of Germany) omits free vector parcels: LDBV FS-BY costs 56,000 EUR/yr (ALKIS 1.80 EUR/parcel), WFS needs framework contracts, and free Parzellarkarte WMS is raster-only without parcel numbers.

Official all-16 consolidation exists only via paid quarterly bulk Shapefiles from ZSHH FS-DE (>=27,000 EUR/yr) + LDBV FS-BY (56,000 EUR/yr), with no API; BKG FS-DE (15 states) is restricted to V GeoBund agencies.

The 15 Open-Data states use incompatible schemas (ave:Flurstueck, adv:AX_Flurstueck, cp:CadastralParcel, custom nora/BE), CRS (EPSG:25832/25833/4326), and WFS CountDefault caps (10k-1M), plus RP offers bulk ZIP only.

Public ALKIS products omit owner/title records (Eigentümer/Grundbuch) and are not legally binding extracts: arc densification adds non-authoritative vertices, and RP/SL include Flurbereinigung pseudo-parcels.
In Esri flstk_DE (53.75M features, excl. Bayern), Shape__Area is distorted Web Mercator EPSG:3857 (~2.3x true area at 49 deg N) — use Amtliche_Fläche__m__ — and unindexed WHERE queries time out.
answer.confidence_reason: Verified all 16 state portals plus ZSHH, BKG, AdV, GovData, EU DVO-HVD FAQ, and Esri flstk_DE; tested live WFS/OAF/REST queries across all 15 Open-Data states and parsed a real NRW GeoPackage download.

FAQ clarifies DVO-HVD (EU) 2023/138 and DNG create no new access claim where state law keeps data fee-bearing (Bavaria).
Federates state HVD INSPIRE Georaum catalog feeds into Geodatenkatalog.de and GovData without hosting a central parcel API.

if_unstructured.summary: The detail explains state services and the ZSHH/LDBV licence route. Public sample data is limited to test locations; Bavaria needs licensed vectors. This is an access guide, not a manual recipe that makes restricted data public.
recipe: For zero-cost coverage of 15/16 states: harvest the 14 state WFS/OAF APIs plus RP bulk dlkm_cp.zip (or tile Esri flstk_DE spatially with maxRecordCount=2000), normalizing Flurstückskennzeichen and m² area fields into EPSG:25832.
CRITICAL AREA FIX: When querying Esri flstk_DE, always read Amtliche_Fläche__m__ and discard Shape__Area (Web Mercator EPSG:3857 inflates area ~2.3x).
To include Bavaria (~20% of Germany by area) legally with vector geometry and area, contract LDBV FS-BY (56,000 EUR/yr) or ZSHH FS-DE + FS-BY (~83,000+ EUR/yr).
if_unstructured.location_method: State-by-state harvesting of 14 WFS/OAF endpoints + RP bulk ZIP (or spatial tiling of Esri flstk_DE), plus commercial ZSHH/LDBV procurement for Bavaria.
cross_with: Geoportal.de / INSPIRE Geoportal metadata records for state endpoint updates
LDBV Bayern Gebühren- und Preisliste for current FS-BY and ALKIS parcel fees

where_published.name: Esri Deutschland flstk_DE FeatureServer/0 (15 Open-Data States API)
where_published.what: Unified queryable CC BY 4.0 REST endpoint covering 53.75M parcels across 15 states (excludes Bavaria).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Query spatially by bounding box (geometryType=esriGeometryEnvelope) in batches <= 2000; read Amtliche_Fläche__m__.

example_document.what_it_gives: Single GeoJSON parcel polygon with Flurstückskennzeichen and official m² area.

where_published.name: ZSHH FS-DE + LDBV FS-BY (Paid All-16 Official Bulk)
where_published.what: Quarterly bulk Shapefiles covering all 16 states when licensing FS-DE (>=27,000 EUR/yr) + FS-BY (56,000 EUR/yr).
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Inspect public test sample FS-DE_shape_utm32.zip and DFB v1.2.1 PDF, then contract via zshh@ldbv.bayern.de.

example_document.what_it_gives: Real 2026 Shapefile sample (Altrip RP + Mannheim BW) with flstkennz and flaeche.

related_not_answering.name: Bayern OpenData WMS Parzellarkarte
related_not_answering.why: CC BY 4.0 raster WMS image service only: explicitly lacks parcel numbers (keine Flurstücksnummern), parcel polygons, and area attributes.

related_not_answering.name: OpenStreetMap Germany (boundary=parcel)
related_not_answering.why: Virtually empty for cadastral parcels (Taginfo Germany reports only 1 way / 4 objects total); OSM Germany excludes cadastral parcel imports.

related_not_answering.name: EuroGeographics Open Maps For Europe 2 (OME2) / OpenCadastralMap
related_not_answering.why: Prototype includes 15 European countries (final batch: BE, EE, IE, HR, CH) and excludes Germany; provides no bulk parcel download.

related_not_answering.name: flurcheck.de ALKIS Viewer
related_not_answering.why: Consumer web lookup over the 15 Open-Data states only (excludes Bavaria); no bulk download or documented public API.

related_not_answering.name: schwarzplan.eu Cadastral Map & MCP/API
related_not_answering.why: Rate-limited MCP/viewer (60 req/hr per IP) over the 15 Open-Data states only; excludes Bavaria and lacks nationwide bulk export.

related_not_answering.name: Boundara Germany Parcel Lookup
related_not_answering.why: Interactive web parcel lookup over 15 Open-Data states; explicitly omits Bavaria and offers no free bulk download.

open_questions: Will Bavaria open ALKIS vector parcels under future EU DVO-HVD / state policy updates? GovData DNG FAQ currently confirms DVO-HVD imposes free API reuse only once state law grants access.
Does Esri Deutschland plan spatial/state indexing and an automated refresh cadence on flstk_DE to fix groupBy timeouts and add live sync?

history.note: Verified all 16 Länder ALKIS portals, ZSHH/LDBV paid 16-state FS-DE+FS-BY, restricted BKG FS-DE, Esri flstk_DE (15 states), and onmaps commercial tiers.

local_terms.meaning: Cadastral parcel — smallest registered land-surveying unit (polygon in ALKIS AX_Flurstück).
Official property cadastre maintained by the 16 Länder (distinct from Grundbuch land title register).
Amtliches Liegenschaftskatasterinformationssystem — AdV GeoInfoDok national data standard implemented per Land.
Official registered parcel area in m² (flaeche/amtlicheFlaeche/areaValue), distinct from computed geometry area.
Cadastral district (sub-municipal survey area identified by 6-digit landschl+gemaschl key).
Cadastral sub-district; blank (___) in Baden-Württemberg, Hamburg, and Sachsen.
Parcel numerator / denominator forming the human-readable parcel number (e.g. 174/84).
